architecture.title: NeMo Data Flywheel — observe → curate → customize → evaluate → promote
architecture.caption: Production traces flow into the Curator funnel, come out as a train.jsonl distillation set, and an A/B eval gate decides whether the cheaper student replaces the teacher. On one ARM64 Spark the honest scope is curate + small LoRA + evaluate; the full Customizer blueprint wants x86 datacenter Kubernetes.
